Running at industry-leading DDR5-12800 speeds, these new MRDIMMs address growing bandwidth demand created by the exponential growth in AI inference and agentic AI workloads. Demonstrating Penguin’s expertise at the intersection of data center AI infrastructure and memory solutions, the SMART Modular MRDIMMs include industry-leading thermal and electrical protections and utilize an innovative architecture that multiplexes two physical ranks into a single logical rank to avoid traditional speed limitations.
